system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Records delivery of produce at the mandi. For your information, my actual_quantity_quintal is dummy_actual_quantity_quintal_4331, my procurement_token is dummy_procurement_token_4396.

function.name: msp_record_produce_delivery
function.description: Records delivery of produce at the mandi. Transitions procurement_status to 'delivered'. Requires session_token. Does NOT perform quality check. Fails if not scheduled, wrong mandi, or exceeding declared quantity.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
